verdict.rationale: Baseten documents first-party function/tool calling, where the model chooses a tool and produces its arguments (baseten-docs-7, baseten-docs-25). It exposes this through OpenAI Chat Completions and Anthropic Messages compatible endpoints (baseten-docs-21, baseten-docs-39). It also documents routing tool-heavy coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex CLI to its Model APIs via Baseten Switch, which implies multi-step agent loops are supported (baseten-docs-22, baseten-docs-34). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of parallel tool calls, explicit documentation of multi-step tool-use reliability or fidelity guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agent loops on open models run without breaking.
